title: Image to ASCII Art Generator
description: Convert any image or photo into retro ASCII text art. Customize density scales, resolutions, color displays, and download your art as plain text.

faqs.question: What is ASCII Art?
faqs.answer: ASCII art is a graphic design technique that uses printable characters from the ASCII specification (such as letters, numbers, and symbols) to form a visual pattern or picture when viewed in a monospace font.

faqs.question: Can I generate colored ASCII art?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our generator features a "Colored" mode that styles each character with the exact pixel color from your source image, making it render in full color.

faqs.question: Why does the text art look stretched or compressed?
faqs.answer: Monospace text characters are taller than they are wide (usually about a 1:1.6 or 1:2 ratio). To prevent your image from looking vertically stretched, our generator automatically scales down the vertical dimension by a correction factor when mapping pixels to characters.

educationalContent.whatIsIt: Image to ASCII Art Generator maps the pixel grids of an image onto a set of ASCII text symbols sorted by brightness (optical density), producing retro text-based graphics.
educationalContent.howToUse:
1. Select an image file.
2. Choose a density scale (standard, blocky, or simple) and set your target width/resolution.
3. Adjust the brightness, contrast, or color toggle settings.
4. Click "Generate ASCII" to view the render.
5. Click "Copy" or "Download" to save your art.
proTips: For best results, use high-contrast images with clean backgrounds (like logos or portrait silhouettes).
If copying to platforms like Discord, wrap the text inside triple backticks (```) to enforce a monospace layout.
